title: Telegram Bot API 10.4 HTML Widget compact state and query contract
description: ВНЕ ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНОГО СКОУПА (2026-11-13, D-014): ТЗ п. 6.2 требует инлайн-кнопки, виджеты Bot API 10.4 — необязательное улучшение. Действующий контракт v1: contracts/event.schema.json, contracts/api.openapi.yaml, contracts/agent_tools.json; см. docs/DECISIONS.md. Contract for native in-bubble HTML widgets in Telegram Bot API 10.4 (sendWidget, editMessageWidgetData, Update.widget_query, answerWidgetQuery). Distinct from contracts/widget_protocol.schema.json, which governs external partner website embeds. Serialized JSON of chat_data, public_data and answerWidgetQuery.data MUST NOT exceed 1024 UTF-8 bytes; serialized WidgetQuery request string MUST be 1-64 UTF-8 bytes ('v1:' + opaque action token). All untrusted strings in state are rendered exclusively via textContent inside the offline QuickJS sandbox.

m.description: Widget view mode: search (Kuray + chips + up to 3 occurrences), plan (saved day timeline), attention (cancelled/changed slot + replacement preview).

r.description: Monotonic server-side render revision; widget ignores answers/events with lower r.

k.description: Active Kuray petal index (0 = none, 1..7 = stage, heritage, live_sound, family_interactive, ethno_crafts, ideas_lectures, walks_routes).

prefixItems.description: Short display label of active constraint chip (e.g. 'Уфа', 'Сб', '7+', '≤1500₽', '~тихое').
1 = hard constraint (deterministic filter), 0 = soft preference (ranking only).
Short opaque server-bound action suffix used to form 'v1:' + token on tap.

c.description: Compact constraint chips tuple list [label, is_hard, action_token].

prefixItems.description: Public occurrence_id from active backend allowlist.
Compact local time or window (e.g. '15:00' or '14:30–16:00').
Truncated plain-text title + venue summary; rendered strictly via textContent.
Explicit price/age badge preserving unknown semantics (e.g. '400₽ · 6+', 'Цена не указ.').
Occurrence status code: 0 = scheduled_verified, 1 = partially_unknown, 2 = cancelled_or_moved, 3 = stale_needs_recheck.
Opaque server-bound action suffix for primary slot tap ('v1:' + token).

s.description: Up to 3 occurrence or timeline slots [occ_id, time, title_venue, price_age_badge, status_code, action_token].

prefixItems.description: Candidate replacement occurrence_id from backend allowlist.
Opaque token to accept replacement ('v1:' + accept_token).
Opaque token to reject replacement and retain saved plan ('v1:' + reject_token).

rep.description: Optional replacement preview tuple shown only when m='attention'.
